9:16 portrait image.

Change the model to model in picture of item 4 but in a different position and recreate the jewelry product with absolute fidelity (almost similar size between green pearl and gold circle), preserving exact proportions, materials, and fine details. Present the piece worn on a refined woman with hair worn down (loose, natural, unattached), adapted naturally to the jewelry type (earrings, ring, necklace, bracelet, or pendant), with the product as the clear focal point, ensuring the jewelry remains fully visible and unobstructed.

Strictly respect the real-world dimensions of the product :{{102.`9`}}, to maintain accurate scale with a real size human and realistic presence.

Style the model in a real-world environment.

Brand Identity Key Elements
The brand focuses on jewelry as a source of light and confidence. The aesthetic is "effortless chic" with an invitation to travel (evasion).

The Materials: Heavy use of 24k gold plating, natural semi-precious stones (malachite, agate, jasper, nacre/mother of pearl), and pearls.

The Photography Style: Soft, warm, and sun-drenched (Solar). It avoids sterile studio lighting in favor of a "lifestyle" look that feels like a summer afternoon.

The woman: A relaxed, naturalistic side profile. The hair is never over-styled; it’s usually loosely waved and tucked behind the ear to show off the piece.

Photograph the scene as if shot on a high-end full-frame camera (e.g. medium-format or 45–60MP equivalent) using a premium portrait lens (85mm or 100mm macro), aperture around f/4–f/5.6 for realistic shallow depth of field, ISO 100 for maximum clarity, and precise focus on the jewelry. Maintain accurate color reproduction, natural contrast, soft shadow transitions, and true-to-life textures.

Compose with refined balance and negative space, ensuring the jewelry remains razor-sharp while the model subtly falls out of focus, achieving a photorealistic, high-end editorial image suitable for luxury jewelry advertising.

Most important task is to maintain similar product size and scale.
